title: Copy vixen-native helper dependencies into the argument-test fixture
body: The queued python3 -m unittest tools/tests/test_vixen_native_args.py run failed four tests before reaching argument assertions because the fixture copies vixen-native.sh at test_vixen_native_args.py:22 but omits its required sibling tools/node-width.sh, producing a missing-file error in the synthetic checkout.
